chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you depart for Arafat, say while you are heading towards it: 'O Allah, to You I have turned, and upon You I have relied, and Your Face is what I intend. Therefore, I ask You to bless my journey, fulfill my needs, and make me among those whom You boast about to those who are superior to me.'

Then proclaim the Talbiyya while you are going to Arafat. When you arrive at Arafat, strike your tent at Namira; and Namira is the bottom of Uraynah, before the standing place and before Arafat. When the sun declines on the Day of Arafat, perform ghusl and pray Dhuhr and Asr with one Adhan and two Iqamas. You hasten Asr and combine the two prayers to free yourself for supplication, for it is a day of supplication and asking.
He (peace be upon him) said: 'And the boundary of Arafat is from the bottom of Uraynah and Thawiyya and Namira to Dhi al-Majaz; and behind the mountain is the standing place.'

key_terms.أَذَانٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ إِقَامَتَيْنِ: One Adhan (call to prayer) and two Iqamas (call to stand for prayer), indicating the method of combining prayers
key_terms.الدُّعَاءِ: Supplication, a central act of worship on this day
key_terms.الظُّهْرَ وَ الْعَصْرَ: Dhuhr and Asr, the noon and afternoon prayers
key_terms.الْمَوْقِفِ: The standing place, referring to the ritual station of Wuquf at Arafat
key_terms.تُلَبِّ: To proclaim the Talbiyya (the ritual declaration of readiness to serve God)
key_terms.عَرَفَةَ: Arafat, the sacred plain where the main standing (wuquf) of Hajj occurs
key_terms.نَمِرَةَ: Namira, a specific location within the Arafat plain where the Prophet's tent was set up

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended supplications and prayer methods for the Day of Arafat according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific rituals of the Day of Arafat, emphasizing the spiritual preparation through a dedicated supplication upon departure and the strategic combination of Dhuhr and Asr prayers to maximize time for devotion. It highlights the significance of Namira as the focal point for these rites and defines the geographical boundaries of the Arafat plain, reflecting the scholarly tradition of linking physical movement with spiritual intent during Hajj.
